meta.read_rule: Use Qoovex-Brain as the canonical operational memory and repository code as truth for implemented state.

project.name: Qoovex
project.audience: small construction businesses, subcontractors, craftspeople and safety consultants
project.positioning: An exception-driven operating system for documents, deadlines and construction-site evidence.
project.promise: Qoovex organizes operational information, executes deterministic and reversible steps, and presents exceptions, decisions and results for review.
project.legal_limit: Qoovex does not guarantee compliance, certify people or documents, or replace professional, technical, medical or legal judgment.

verified_current_state.summary: The current product is a protected operational document platform with a situation-centric dashboard, not yet a persistent process engine.
active_domain: document types, requirements, documents and private versions
document packages and controlled share links
product audit, support and data control
verified_current_state.security: Authorization, organizationId and resource scope are server-derived and default-deny. Prisma stores data and metadata; private Vercel Blob stores binaries.
not_implemented: persistent operational processes, steps, proposals, decisions and exceptions
OCR or AI document extraction and classification
verified_current_state.migration_history: The repository contains nine canonical migration directories through 20260725010000_add_session_account_user_indexes; applied state must be verified separately for each environment.

approved_direction.operating_model: event -> interpretation -> plan -> deterministic automatic actions -> exception when judgment or authorization is required -> human decision -> reconciled result -> operational timeline
approved_direction.domain_and_processes: Existing domain entities remain sources, outputs and advanced detail. Processes become the future first-class product concept and must not duplicate domain records.
approved_direction.primary_experience: Da fare evolves into an operational center for decisions, running work, blocks and results. A universal intake replaces global CRUD quick actions. Complete domain views remain available for control, correction and configuration.
automation_principles: deterministic context, confirmed relations and validated rules before OCR, matching or AI
automatic execution only when reliability, impact, reversibility, authorization and approved policy allow it
technical retries are handled by the system; business uncertainty becomes an exception
external sharing always requires an explicit authorized decision
success is measured by manual work avoided, not feature usage

execution_policy.automatic: Deterministic and reversible low-impact work supported by confirmed context or validated policy.
execution_policy.confirmation_required: Fallible classifications or dates, non-inherited associations, invitations, assignments, retroactive model application, exclusions, sharing and corrections to confirmed data.
execution_policy.forbidden_without_future_decision: Compliance declarations, regulatory deductions, certifications, role or access expansion, unapproved sensitive processing, external disclosure of reserved data, permanent deletion, Organization deletion, Blob cleanup, silent history changes and continuous surveillance or geolocation.

approved_direction.exceptions: An exception is persistent operational work with a reason, consequence, authorized resolver and resume condition. A notification is only a delivery channel and cannot close an exception by itself.
approved_direction.timeline_and_audit: The operational timeline explains process progress and decisions to authorized users. Product audit remains a separate, minimized, technical accountability record.
process_guarantees: idempotent at event, process and step level
protected by atomic claim and fencing
approved_direction.rules: Validated rules are versioned inputs. A process must retain the rule version used and a rule change must not silently rewrite history.

conceptual_not_implemented.warning: These names and blueprints are conceptual specifications. They do not authorize TypeScript contracts, Prisma models, migrations, routes, runners, providers or UI changes.

phase_1: The domain remains rich while the primary interface becomes small.
One universal intake replaces many global quick actions.
Validated rules are Qoovex operational memory.
Statuses, deadlines and reminders are derived when policy and data allow it.
Checklists and packages become process outputs.
External sharing is the explicit result of a reviewed process.
The operational timeline becomes a central product object.
Manual correction and advanced control remain available.
Success is measured through manual work avoided.
phase_2: Process becomes a first-class product concept.
Existing domain entities remain sources and outputs.
Reliability and impact jointly decide execution.
Exceptions are the user's primary work.
Operational timeline and technical audit remain separate.
Every process is idempotent and resumable.
Technical failures are retried by the system before involving users.
AI does not determine regulatory obligations or compliance.
Success is measured through manual work avoided.

open_hard_stops: final process entity names and structure
roles authorized for each proposal and decision
rule changes on already open processes
recommended_future_sequence: implement the minimal timeline and operational-center read model
integrate decisions and exceptions into the dashboard
add approved fallible extraction behind an adapter
add continuous control and internally reconciled packages
measure manual work before and after

technical_state.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 uses CSS-first configuration in the Next.js apps.
technical_state.typography: Sirio, web and workspace load Geist and Geist Mono through next/font; @qoovex/brand-resources is asset-only.
technical_state.design_system: @qoovex/ui is the shared shadcn base-nova foundation with Base UI, Tabler and the Vercel light/dark/system theme; domain compositions remain app-local.
technical_state.workspace_architecture: apps/workspace owns product pages, auth, MFA, API and server orchestration; no process-engine implementation exists.
technical_state.database_environments: Production, Preview, local development and CI use distinct guarded targets; current migration application state must be verified per environment before rollout.
technical_state.database_operations: Every database-sensitive task applies docs/OperationalProtocol.md#database-operation-impact and preserves correctness, authorization and tenant isolation.
